evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: The current QC release plan (2021) requires fineness of grind testing using a Hegman gauge for AF-12 and EF-210.
evidence.quote: Fineness of grind (Hegman gauge) on AF-12 and EF-210.

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: Fineness of grind testing via Hegman gauge was already part of the QC release plan in 1996.

evidence.title: QP-02 batch release - acceptance criteria
evidence.claim: As of 2021, fineness of grind is a release criterion for all products based on specifications and contracts.
evidence.quote: Viscosity and fineness of grind are release criteria for all products

evidence.title: QC RELEASE PLAN - QP-02 Batch QC release
evidence.claim: Fineness of grind testing using a Hegman gauge was part of the first controlled issue of the QC release plan in 1994.

evidence.title: Technical data sheet - AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
evidence.claim: For AF-12, fineness of grind is required to ensure dispersion quality, gloss, and anti-corrosion performance (2023).
evidence.quote: Fineness of grind: 6 Hegman minimum (dispersion quality, gloss and anti-corrosion performance).

evidence.title: CUSTOMER CLAIM CL-2004-003
evidence.claim: A 2004 customer claim for EF-210 reported pinholes and craters, indicating a failure in coating quality.
evidence.quote: Complaint: pinholes and craters across the floor; recoating required.

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-2003-015
evidence.claim: In 2003, EF-210 batches showed grit and lumps due to caked quartz flour from Silicati Brenta.
evidence.quote: grit and lumps visible in the applied film. Cause: caked paper bags of quartz flour from Silicati Brenta

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2010-003 - Quarzi Monterosso S.p.A.
evidence.claim: In 2010, Silicati Brenta was replaced by Quarzi Monterosso S.p.A. as the quartz flour supplier for EF-210 to avoid lumps.
evidence.quote: Replaces Silicati Brenta paper bags from April 2010.

evidence.title: FATTURA / INVOICE n. 4219/14
evidence.claim: Quarzi Monterosso S.p.A. was still supplying quartz flour for the plant in 2014.
evidence.quote: Item: Quartz flour 0.1 mm, big-bag 1 t.
